homemade from 400 g can diced tomatoes + can-splash of water (s1)

1/2 tsp dried italian herbs in crumb (s2)

causalSequence: simmer garlic, canned tomato, dried herbs into a quick marinara; cool
halve or butterfly breasts into thin even pieces; season
crumb: flour, beaten egg, breadcrumbs; press crumbs on firmly
shallow-fry 3-4 min per side until golden and cooked
top fried chicken with ham, marinara, cheese
grill or bake until cheese melts and bubbles
techniqueFacts: all three thin the breast for even fast cooking: s1 butterflies (love-heart), s0 butterflies whole 1 kg breasts, s2 halves lengthways then flattens to ~3 mm with a mallet
s0 dry-brines: salt the cut breast, rest in fridge 20-60 min, pat dry — claimed crisper crumb
standard 3-bowl crumb line in all three; s0 and s2 mix parmesan and seasonings into the crumbs
sauce is homemade in s0/s1 (canned tomato + garlic base, 8-20 min simmer, cooled before topping so the crust stays crisp); s2 shortcuts with store marinara
ham layer sits between chicken and sauce in s1/s2; s0 omits ham entirely
melt stage: oven grill/broiler 3-4 min (s1, s2); s0 bakes at 180 C until golden
doneness targets differ: s1 pulls at 62 C internal from ~180 C oil; s0 cooks to 73 C internal
s1 frames it as the pub plate: chips and green salad alongside, mozzarella must be block not fresh (fresh is too wet, goes soggy)
